description: Five-question executive read on platform reliability — is it healthy, are customers impacted, are there active critical incidents, are SLAs at risk, is reliability improving. Every panel except Reliability Score reads a value the platform already computes for its own operational dashboards (SlaRecord, Incident, Alert); Reliability Score is the one new composite, computed live in SQL from those same tables — see docs/architecture/adr/0009 sibling design note in the dashboard's own panel description below. No per-service filter on purpose: this is a single fleet-wide screen, not a drill-down tool — use BankOps Fleet Operations for that.

panels.title: Reliability Score
panels.description: Composite: 40% SLA compliance + 20% Tier-1 availability + 25% (100 − normalized MTTR) + 15% (100 − open-P1 penalty), all from each service's latest monthly SlaRecord plus a live open-incident count. The only calculation on this dashboard that isn't a direct read of an existing column.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest_monthly AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.id) s.id AS service_id, s.tier, sla."actualPercent"::float AS actual_pct,
         sla.breached, sla."meanTimeToRecoverMinutes"::float AS mttr
  FROM services s
  LEFT JOIN sla_records sla ON sla."serviceId" = s.id AND sla."windowType" = 'MONTHLY'
  WHERE s."archivedAt" IS NULL
  ORDER BY s.id, sla."windowStart" DESC
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN breached THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS sla_compliance_pct,
    avg(actual_pct) FILTER (WHERE tier = 'TIER_1') AS tier1_availability_pct,
    avg(mttr) AS avg_mttr_minutes,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM incidents WHERE severity = 'SEV1' AND status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')) AS open_p1_count
  FROM latest_monthly
)
SELECT round((
  0.40 * coalesce(sla_compliance_pct, 100)
  + 0.20 * coalesce(tier1_availability_pct, 100)
  + 0.25 * greatest(0, 100 - coalesce(avg_mttr_minutes, 0) / 120 * 100)
  + 0.15 * (100 - least(100, open_p1_count * 25))
)::numeric, 1) AS "Reliability Score"
FROM agg

panels.title: Availability (Tier-1, this month)
panels.description: Traffic-tier-weighted: plain average of Tier-1 services' current-month actualPercent.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(avg(sla."actualPercent"::float)::numeric, 3) AS "Availability"
FROM sla_records sla
JOIN services s ON s.id = sla."serviceId"
WHERE sla."windowType" = 'MONTHLY' AND s.tier = 'TIER_1'
  AND sla."windowStart" = (SELECT max("windowStart") FROM sla_records WHERE "windowType" = 'MONTHLY')

panels.title: SLA Compliance (this month)
panels.description: Share of services whose latest monthly SlaRecord is not breached.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN breached THEN 0 ELSE 1 END), 1) AS "SLA Compliance"
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.id) sla.breached
  FROM services s
  LEFT JOIN sla_records sla ON sla."serviceId" = s.id AND sla."windowType" = 'MONTHLY'
  WHERE s."archivedAt" IS NULL
  ORDER BY s.id, sla."windowStart" DESC
) latest

panels.title: Reliability trend (90d vs prior 90d)
panels.description: Incident volume, trailing 90 days vs. the 90 days before that. Negative is improving.

targets.rawSql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE "openedAt" >= now() - interval '90 days') AS recent,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE "openedAt" >= now() - interval '180 days' AND "openedAt" < now() - interval '90 days') AS prior
  FROM incidents
)
SELECT CASE WHEN prior = 0 THEN 0 ELSE round(100.0 * (recent - prior) / prior, 1) END AS "90d change"
FROM counts

panels.title: Active incidents (not yet resolved)
panels.description: Every incident whose status isn't RESOLVED or CLOSED — the answer to "active critical incidents" with the context an executive actually needs.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT i.severity AS "Severity", s.name AS "Service", i.title AS "Title", i.status AS "Status", i."openedAt" AS "Opened"
FROM incidents i JOIN services s ON s.id = i."primaryServiceId"
WHERE i.status NOT IN ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')
ORDER BY i.severity, i."openedAt" DESC

panels.title: Active alerts by severity
panels.description: Currently-firing alerts, grouped by severity — every tier shown explicitly, including zero.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sev AS "Severity", count(a.id) AS "Firing"
FROM unnest(ARRAY['SEV1', 'SEV2', 'SEV3', 'SEV4']) AS sev
LEFT JOIN alerts a ON a.severity::text = sev AND a.state = 'FIRING'
GROUP BY sev
ORDER BY sev

panels.title: MTTR (fleet-wide, this month)
panels.description: Average meanTimeToRecoverMinutes across every service's latest monthly SlaRecord.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(avg(sla."meanTimeToRecoverMinutes"::float)::numeric, 1) AS "MTTR"
FROM sla_records sla
WHERE sla."windowType" = 'MONTHLY'
  AND sla."windowStart" = (SELECT max("windowStart") FROM sla_records WHERE "windowType" = 'MONTHLY')

panels.title: MTTD (fleet-wide, this month)
panels.description: Average meanTimeToDetectMinutes across every service's latest monthly SlaRecord.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(avg(sla."meanTimeToDetectMinutes"::float)::numeric, 1) AS "MTTD"
FROM sla_records sla
WHERE sla."windowType" = 'MONTHLY'
  AND sla."windowStart" = (SELECT max("windowStart") FROM sla_records WHERE "windowType" = 'MONTHLY')

panels.title: Incident trend (monthly, by severity)
panels.description: Slope matters more than level — is the mix of severities getting lighter over time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('month', i."openedAt") AS time, i.severity AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM incidents i
WHERE $__timeFilter(i."openedAt")
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Service availability — the drill-down
panels.description: Current status and this month's actualPercent, every service, worst tiers first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.name AS "Service", s.tier AS "Tier", s.status AS "Status",
  round(coalesce(latest."actualPercent"::float, 0)::numeric, 2) AS "This Month %"
FROM services s
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT "actualPercent" FROM sla_records sla
  WHERE sla."serviceId" = s.id AND sla."windowType" = 'MONTHLY'
  ORDER BY "windowStart" DESC LIMIT 1
) latest ON true
WHERE s."archivedAt" IS NULL
ORDER BY s.tier, s.name
